description: Use this when a ShipMyCar quote draft needs checking before generation. It only inspects the draft and returns route requirements, enabled services, missing fields, and next questions.

address.description: Collection or delivery address, town or postcode.

country.description: Country name, for example United Kingdom.

countryCode.description: Two-letter country code, for example GB.

anyOf.description: Address including country, for example London, United Kingdom.

contact.description: Optional. Store these details only with contactConsent on quote_generate.

address.description: Collection or delivery address, town or postcode.

country.description: Country name, for example United Kingdom.

countryCode.description: Two-letter country code, for example GB.

anyOf.description: Address including country, for example London, United Kingdom.

hmrcDetails.description: HMRC estimate answers. Prefer booleans for yes/no questions and ask the user when unknown; never assume relief eligibility.

hasEuExporterNumber.description: Can the seller supply the required EU Registered Exporter Number?

hasEuStatementOnOrigin.description: Can the seller supply a Statement on Origin proving EU manufacture?

hasJapanCorporateNumber.description: Can the seller supply their 13-digit Japan Corporate Number?

hasJapanStatementOnOrigin.description: Can the seller supply a Japanese Statement on Origin?

importReason.description: Personal: personal-use, moving-to-uk, gift, inheritance or returning. Commercial: vat-registered or not-vat-registered. Purchase and relocation aliases are accepted.

isBuiltInJapan.description: Was the vehicle manufactured in Japan? Ask when required by quote_get_requirements.

isReturningVehicle.description: For returning vehicles: was it UK registered before export?

livedOutsideUk12Months.description: For moving-to-uk: has the importer lived outside the UK for at least 12 months?

ownedCar6Months.description: For moving-to-uk: has the importer owned and used the vehicle abroad for at least 6 months?

previouslyRegisteredInUk.description: For returning vehicles previously UK registered: did the importer own it at export and continuously while abroad?

registrationCountry.description: Country where the vehicle is currently registered. Required even if collection country is known.

includeDestinationImportTaxes.description: Always enabled for UK imports; domestic quotes cover transport only.

targetCurrency.description: Currency for the quote, normally GBP.

nonRunner.description: True if the vehicle cannot be driven.

shippingMethod.description: open or enclosed; open is the default.

vehicle.description: Manual vehicle details. VINs are ignored and never sent for lookup.

currency.description: Currency of the actual vehicle value, for example EUR, USD, JPY or GBP. Required for imports.

shippingSizeId.description: Known shipping size identifier, if available. Supply year, make and model manually; VIN lookups are disabled.

value.description: Actual purchase or current market value, required for every import to the UK. UK domestic quotes may use an approximate value or valueBand.

anyOf.description: Legacy natural-language quote details or a JSON-encoded draft. Prefer the object format.

draft.description: Current MCP quote draft to inspect.

name: quote_get_requirements
title: Get quote requirements
